newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Overnight guilders ease a touch but stay high.
newsitem.headline: Overnight guilders ease a touch but stay high.

text.p: Overnight guilders started higher on Monday, but rates eased later as early salary payments flowed into the market.

Dealers said some early deals in one-day money had been done at 3.06 percent, but that later in the session call money rates had dipped to 2.93 percent. This compares with an official rate on special advances of just 2.50 percent.
Dealers said most activity was focused on call money, with overall volumes low.
Three-month guilders were quoted up two basis points at 2.96 percent bid but changing hands at about 3.02 percent, they said.
They said rates were sticking at highs due to the guilder's relative weakness against the mark.
The guilder was quoting at around 112.35 per 100 marks on Monday, a touch softer than Friday's 112.345 fixing.
